## Objective
- Build a complete, playable airplane travel game with a house-to-airport journey, world destinations, ticketed landing city, cabin classes, fun passes, admin privileges, and in-game currency for house upgrades.

- Journey includes home, taxi, luggage drop, security, boarding, flight, and landing.
- First class: 30; business class: 100; fun passes: week 12, month 39, year 100. Show worldwide currency estimates converted to Saudi riyals.
- Admin uses an access code and pays nothing.
- Ticket shows the landing destination from the beginning.
- House expenses use game money, not real money.
- User asked to create the game without clarification.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based game called Cloudbound with a 10-city destination list, demo currency only, and illustrative currency conversions; no real payments are taken.
- Admin demo code is `SKY777`.
- Used localStorage for game progress and coins.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser airplane travel game with a house-to-airport journey, worldwide destinations, cabin/pass options, admin privileges, and game-currency house upgrades.

## Requirements
- Journey stages: home, taxi, luggage drop, security, boarding, flight, and landing.
- First class: 30; business class: 100; fun passes: week 12, month 39, year 100; show illustrative worldwide currency estimates converted to SAR.
- Admin uses an access code and pays nothing.
- Ticket displays the landing city from the start; house upgrades use game money, not real money.
- User asked to build without clarification.

## Decisions
- Built a browser game named Cloudbound with 10 destinations and localStorage progress.
- Currency amounts are demo estimates only; no real payments are taken. Demo admin code is `SKY777`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game UI, destination selection, ticket, taxi fare, baggage-weight interaction, security tray interaction, boarding, flight lane mini-game, game coins, house upgrades, currency selector, cabin/pass options, and admin mode.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser-tested booking through taxi, luggage, security, and boarding; destination remained on the ticket throughout.
- Home screenshot saved at `/tmp/opencode/cloudbound-home.jpg`.

### Active
- Continue browser testing from boarding through flight and landing; check interaction errors and fix any found.
- Review `git status` before reporting final changes.

### Blocked
- Browser console has a 404 for `/favicon.ico`; no gameplay errors observed so far.

## Next Move
1. Click “View ticket & board,” verify ticket details and enter flight.
2. Play all five flight turns and verify landing, coin reward, and new-trip flow.
3. Re-run `node --check game.js`, inspect `git status`, then summarize implementation and demo assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game page structure.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and visual design.
- `game.js`: game state, journey interactions, currency display, admin, and mini-game.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Demo currency figures are illustrative; no real-money checkout exists.
- Admin demo code is `SKY777`.
- Development server is at `http://localhost:3002`.
